title: Training children in extraocular vision in Mexico and Spain

tellings.quote: there's the whole group's training children to do this in Mexico and in Spain and I don't know whether there's much happening in the US or Britain but I know about it from Spain because I have a colleague in Spain who's working on this

plain: Groups in Mexico and Spain are said to be training children in extraocular vision, the claimed ability to see or read without using the eyes. The biologist Rupert Sheldrake mentions it, saying he knows about the Spanish work because "I have a colleague in Spain who's working on this," while adding he does not know whether much is happening in the US or Britain.
